Kwame, I couldn't set up the 09:00 digest. The scheduler refused the request because the gateway has no credentials configured, so nothing recurring exists yet. I haven't promised a digest I can't deliver.

I did check the channel. You're a member of #coastal-team, and I read it as you would. The last messages are from 2026-02-17, so nothing is new as of today. I've saved a starting point, so new messages from now on will be the ones included.

Once the gateway's scheduler is connected (an operator would need to fix its auth config), I can create the job: 09:00 America/Chicago daily, a DM to you, with money terms left out (I'd point you to the channel for those). If you'd rather not wait, I can send you a digest by hand whenever you ask.
